title: YEEZY BOOST 380
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Onyx Non-Reflective’ delivers a subdued rendition of the minimalist lifestyle sneaker. A charcoal grey finish dominates the re-engineered Primeknit upper, with inky black and a subtle streak of navy blue surrounding the translucent monofilament window. The sock-like build sits atop a full-length Boost midsole, encaged in semi-translucent rubber and supported underfoot by a herringbone traction outsole.

title: YEEZY 500 HIGH
description: The adidas Yeezy 500 High ‘Taupe Black’ dresses the boot-like silhouette in murky earth tones. No-tie elastic laces secure an upper crafted from dark taupe elastane with suede and leather overlays in varying shades of brown. A durable rubber wrap offers lightweight support and abrasion resistance, while reflective piping along the mudguard provides added visibility in low-light conditions. The high-top rests on a sculpted adiPRENE+ midsole inspired by adidas’ retro Feet You Wear technology from the ‘90s.
